title: Fed Cuts to Zero and Pledges Open-Ended Bond Buying
dek: The Federal Reserve’s balance sheet climbs from $4.3 trillion to almost $7.2 trillion in under three months.
body: Rates went to zero on 15 March. On 23 March the Fed pledged to buy Treasuries and mortgage bonds “in the amounts needed.”

panels.label: Powell Says
panels.text: Powell says the Fed “crossed a lot of red lines” and that in this crisis “you do that and then you figure it out.”

panels.label: Summers Says
panels.text: Summers says the Fed’s easy-money signals are creating “a dangerous complacency” in markets.

panels.label: The Stakes
panels.text: One side says the rescue saved jobs and markets, the other that it stoked bubbles and inflation; at stake is how far a central bank may go.
